SMTO-CFG-0022 — SMTO couldn't use this conversation's saved settings

GUID: b23e24dc-8de8-472d-a874-3dca9dd7e8c7
Slug: composer-profile-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • Either the settings stored with this conversation, like its mode, Gateway and output limit, can't be read, or its Output limit is lower than the minimum your model setup now requires. SMTO won't send messages here until that is fixed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you set an Output limit for this conversation, select Default next to it, or drag the slider higher, then send again. The model's minimum may have been raised since you set the limit, and the Default setting always passes this check.
  2. If the message box keeps showing this error, select New chat in the Conversations pane and send your message there. A new conversation starts with fresh settings, and the old one stays in your list.
  3. Ask the person who manages SMTO to check Minimum tokens for the model that makes the Agent's decisions (usually Main) in Settings › Setup › Model routing. That minimum decides the smallest Output limit SMTO accepts.

What success looks like

  • No error appears above the message box, and your message starts a task.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the conversation; its saved settings are needed to work out what went wrong.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Composer profile validation failed: either the conversation's saved profile is not a valid object with the required fields, or the submitted max_completion_tokens is below the current output_token_min from model routing.

What this means

  • Saved composer data fails JSON/object/required-field/model validation, or submission's output-token override is below the current configured minimum. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Saved composer data fails JSON/object/required-field/model validation, or submission's output-token override is below the current configured minimum.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect schema validity and output_token_min separately; not every rejection proves persisted profile corruption.

How to fix it

  • If the output check failed, raise max_completion_tokens to at least output_token_min (the agent-decision model's min_tokens override in Settings › Setup › Model routing) or set it to null. If the stored profile is unreadable, inspect that conversation's composer profile record for non-object data, missing required fields or rejected values, and restore it from a matching backup.
  • Correct the identified profile or output-budget constraint in the supported composer editor.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The current profile validates and the intended output allowance meets the accepted minimum.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
